entries.en:
The Dezul Qualan's instrument panel is a complex piece of machinery─too complex, in fact, for the clumsy claws of even the most skilled Ixali crafter. Impressed with your work on larger items, Rozol Cattlan believes it time to test your hand at tasks which require more precision. The materials he was able to provide you with; however, the bribe for young Templeton you will have to earn on your own. For whatever reason, he requires a biast claw, of all things. Fortunately, the hills to the west of the Observatorium are literally crawling with hungry biasts.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.

entries.en:
Templeton is every bit as despicable as advertised, and now you have full access to the Highwind Skyways temporary crafting facilities. Use the materials given to you by the Rozol Cattlan and inspected by Templeton to synthesize a high-quality instrument panel component, and deliver the finished product to the faction.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Production II wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Templeton.

entries.en: You have delivered the expertly crafted instrument panel component to Rozol Cattlan the Prudent, leaving him in awe at your skill as well as your willingness to assist his faction, despite the fact you and he are so different. He makes it a point to voice his gratitude to Chief Sezul Totoloc who has made possible this once unthinkable alliance.
entries.fr: Vous avez apporté <frnoun(ItemHQ,2,　8103,1,1)> à Rozol Cattlan, qui vous a remercié<if(gnum4,e,)> pour le soin que vous avez apporté à une pièce d'une grande importance pour la fiabilité du Dezul Qualan. Il vous a également avoué s'être longtemps senti inutile au sein des Planeurs d'Ehcatl et avoir aujourd'hui enfin l'impression d'apporter sa pierre à l'édifice en facilitant le travail d'artisans tels que vous.

entries.fr: Ce dernier sera cer<->tai<->ne<->ment plus réceptif si <if(gnum4,celle-là,celui-là)> lui fait don d'une griffe qu'il pourra obtenir en allant chasser <frnoun(BNpcName,1,　788,1,1)> à l'ouest de l'Observatoire.

entries.en: Oh, whatever will I do? Without that biast claw, whatever will I do!?
entries.fr: Oh, vous avez apporté <frnoun(EventItem,1,2001405,1,1)>, rien que pour moi<nbsp>? Comment avez-vous su<nbsp>? Avec le froid, j'ai la peau toute desséchée et ça me démange de partout, mais je n'arrive pas à me gratter dans le creux du dos<nbsp>! Montrez-moi donc cette petite merveille.
entries.ja:
ほう……私へのおみやげとして、
「」をいただけるとっ……？
そのかわりに、ここを使用したいのですねっ？

entries.en: Why, if it isn't a biast claw! How apropos! Me minus that appendage would have left me stuck in a pickle without a paddle...or something like that.
entries.fr: Parfait<nbsp>! C'est tout juste la longueur qu'il me fallait. Grâce à vous, je vais enfin pouvoir arrêter de me tortiller dans tous les sens pour me soulager. C'est que les gens commençaient à me regarder d'un drôle d'œil...
entries.ja:
ハイハイ、いいですともっ！
「」は矢尻の材料になるとかで、
ここの商人に売りつけられますからねっ！

entries.en: You see, I promised a certain sutler I'd sell him one...before recalling I had little talent at, well, slaying things and such. And hence my dilemma─without that claw, not only would I appear the fool in the eyes of that swiving sutler, but I'd also be forced to use my own coin to purchase that cask of red I'm having delivered later this evening. But lo, my dilemma is solved!
entries.fr: (Quelle chance d'être responsable de ces ins<->tal<->la<->tions<nbsp>! Même s'il fait un froid de canard dans la région, ça a au moins l'avantage de me faire bénéficier de tous ces avantages en nature, héhé...) Euh, on va dire que vous n'avez rien entendu, d'accord<nbsp>?
entries.ja:
会社の施設をまた貸しして小遣い稼ぎ……くふふふっ。
おっと、今の不適切発言はなかったことにしてくださいねっ！

entries.en: Very well, then. You are free to use the facilities here as you see fit. Just try not to damage anything. A lot of unnecessary paperwork that would be. Ah, and I suppose you shall be wanting these materials returned, as well. Hm? Did I inspect them thoroughly? I don't know. Did it <italic(1)>appear<italic(0)> that I did? Good then! \<wink> \<wink>

entries.en: If you need aught else, feel free to ask. I'll be right here buffing the biast...claw.
entries.fr: Si jamais vous échouez, ce que je ne vous souhaite pas, ou que vous décidez de remettre votre travail à plus tard, je vous prierai de me mettre au courant.
entries.ja:
材料が必要でしたら、私からお渡ししますっ。
また使いたいときには、ひと声かけてくださいねっ！

entries.en: It appears you've completed that contraption of yours. I shall not ask what it is for if you promise to remove it from here at once. It would be simply tragic if one of my supervisors were to walk in and I had to tell them of how you threatened to pierce mine optics with this deadly claw if I didn't allow you access to our equipment. \<wink> \<wink>

entries.ja:
おや？　もう納品に行かなくてよろしいのですかっ？
もしも製作した品をなくしたりして、作りなおすときは、
私に声をかけてくださいねっ！

entries.en: Sqwak! Yet another sound piece, you bring... Yet confounded, I remain. Mistrust the featherless ones, we did. For so long, we did. In our hearts, much hate, do we still harbor. Despite recent relations, do we still harbor. Sqwak...
entries.fr: Magnifique<nbsp>! Grâce à <if(gnum4,celle-là,celui-là)>, le Dezul Qualan sera équipé d'instruments de navigation très fiables et pourra voler en toute sécurité à travers les orages les plus violents.
entries.ja:
フムッゥ……、さすがですなッァ。
これで計器を作れば、が雲に突っ込んでも、
周囲の状況が手に取るようにわかるというもんですわッァ！

entries.en: Yet, still, your hand, you lend. Your judgment, you refuse. Sqwak! To recognize this quality within you, wise was the chieftain. Sqwak! Why, it is that chieftain, he is, and but counter of knots, I remain.
entries.fr: De nombreuses années ont passé depuis qu'oncle Sezul a pris celui-ci sous son aile, et il a pour la première fois le sentiment de se rendre utile. Celui-ci va continuer à faire tout son possible pour encourager le travail des artisans comme <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)> au service des “Planeurs d'Ehcatl”<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
セズルの旦那に拾われて、ン十年……。
手配と勘定しかできない私ですが、せめて職人サンたちの、
仕事のお膳立てくらいは続けたいものですなッァ。

entries.en: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
